_comment: Copy to launch_defaults.local.json (gitignored) beside this file, or at the repo root, and edit. tools/sync_launch_targets.ps1 stamps these onto .vs/launch.vs.json, which is gitignored and therefore disposable. 'all' applies to every target; 'targets' keys match the projectTarget label exactly or as a wildcard. Values here win over what is already in launch.vs.json.
_env_reference: HONUWARE_DB_HOST (default localhost on Windows, postgresql on Linux), _PORT (5432), _USER (docker), _PASSWORD (docker), _NAME (app-supplied - overriding it points at a different database), _SSLMODE (prefer in release, unset in debug), _SSLROOTCERT. Legacy KNOTTYYOGA_DB_* names are accepted as fallbacks. Other vars: HONUWARE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE (must be exactly "1" to permit drop-and-recreate), HONUWARE_LOG_DEST, HONUWARE_SECRET_KEY, HONUWARE_ORIGIN_SECRET, HONUWARE_TRUST_PROXY, HONUWARE_DEV_CORS_ORIGIN, HONUWARE_CONTROL_DB_NAME, HONUWARE_TENANT_MODE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE.

targets._comment_targets: Wildcards match the full projectTarget label, including the nested 'name.exe (sub\dir\name.exe)' form.
